newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde March 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde March 7.

text.p: These are leading stories in today's afternoon daily Le Monde, dated March 8
-- Government favours quotas for women candidates to legislative office. A majority of deputies polled by Le Monde oppose the idea.
-- Basque Nationalist Party chairman Xabier Arzalluz tells Le Monde "This time, I think ETA wants to negotiate."
-- Pechiney upcoming sale of Carbone Lorraine stake, valued at about 780 million francs, is the group's last readily sellable asset.
-- Trade unions call Friday one-hour strike at all Renault plants in Europe and stress urgent need for Europe-wide social policy for the auto industry.
-- IG Bau-Agrar-Umwelttrade union leader Klaus Wieshehugel tells Le Monde the single currency may signal the end of Europe's welfare systems.
-- Swiss and Italian researchers report smokers' trend toward "light" cigarettes does not lower lung cancer risk
